proposition.claim:
Equation reference: eq:scheme. The equation is \[i\partial_tu=Hu+Wu+\varepsilon |u|^{2\sigma}u,\qquad H=-\Delta+V.\] Assumption 1.1 (p. 2) requires real smooth \(V\ge1\), with all derivatives of order at least two bounded, and real \(W\in W^{2,\infty}\). The nonlinear subflow is \(N(t)v=v\exp(-itW-it\varepsilon |v|^{2\sigma})\) (p. 3). On p. 4 the cutoff satisfies \[\chi\in C_c^\infty(\mathbb R;[0,1]),\qquad
 \chi=1\text{ on }[-1,1],\qquad \chi=0\text{ outside }[-2,2].\] Equations (1.4)–(1.6) define, with \(P=\Pi_\lambda\), \[
 P=\chi^2(H/\lambda),\quad S(t)=e^{-itH},\quad S_\lambda(t)=PS(t),
 \qquad u^0=Pu_0,\quad u^{j+1}=S_\lambda(\tau)N(\tau)u^j.\] The main theorems set \(\lambda=\tau^{-1}\). Theorem 1.4 (p. 5) gives an \(L^2\) error of order \(\tau^{1/2}\) for the specified \(\mathcal H^1\) regime; Theorem 1.5 (p. 6) gives \(L^2\) order \(\tau\) and \(\mathcal H^1\) order \(\tau^{1/2}\) for the stated \(\mathcal H^2\) regime, assuming the exact solution exists on \([0,T]\). Their constants may depend on \(T\) and the problem data.

Kind: paraphrase

Locator: PDF p.27, (5.10), against p.4, (1.4)-(1.6)

Text: u^(m+n)=P S(n tau)u^m+sum_{k=0}^{n-1}P S((n-k)tau)(N(tau)-I)u^(m+k), while the defined one-step map is P S(tau)N(tau).

d=1; V=1; W=0; sigma=1; epsilon=+1. lambda>=2; tau=1/lambda. chi smooth compactly supported in [-2,2], range [0,1], equal 1 on [-1,1]. Nonzero smooth compact Fourier support where 1/4<p(xi)<3/4, p=chi^2((xi^2+1)/lambda). g=P f; u0=a f in Schwartz; 0<a<=min(1,sqrt(2c/(tau M))). c=||(P^2-P)g||2>0; M=||g||infty^2||g||2>0. Actual nonlinear evolution remains epsilon=+1; required H1/H2 regularity and defocusing/subcritical local/global existence regime satisfied.
